peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 1.9% above its local comparables; 65 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (40.3): 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 43 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 95.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $918,000 ($1,482 psf, 505–678 sq ft; 15 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,537 psf (range $1,366–1,769); 3.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $34,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,385,000 ($1,693 psf, 807–839 sq ft; 9 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,578 psf (range $1,356–1,926); 7.3% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $94,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Hillview MRT about 350 m, Cashew MRT about 760 m; closer than 69 of 116 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ Our Lady Queen of Peace about 540 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

nearest.name: CHIJ Our Lady Queen of Peace

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 40 m), more than 7 of 116 similar developments (the same as 19); nearest hawker centre Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre about 1,870 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 260 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Hillhaven, 13 new sales, about 120 m; The Botany at Dairy Farm, 2 new sales, about 1,020 m; The Myst, 46 new sales, about 1,160 m; Narra Residences, 214 new sales, about 1,290 m; The Arden, 3 new sales, about 1,770 m; The Sen, 177 new sales, about 1,840 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 64 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 455 new sales and 511 resales (966 purchases); new sales were 47.1% of these purchases. Subsales (27) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dairy Farm Walk GLS site (Jan 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,030 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 511 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 85 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 511 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 554 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.8%). Planning-area private resales −2.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
